integrity: Embedded standalone exact-integer dynamic-programming and independent C++ depth-first enumeration; mathematical parity lower bounds and explicit optimal witnesses. Finite computational enumeration is complete in the stated finite domain.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for four labeled DNA bases, all homopolymer-free three-mer reverse-complement orbits, and either linear or circular host words. No biochemical binding efficacy or general-window theorem follows; unindexed prior calculations remain a literature-priority risk.
title: Sharp strand-agnostic covers of homopolymer-free DNA trinucleotides
